items.source: The default is "false", considering all BeanInfo metadata classes, like for standard Introspector.getBeanInfo(Class) calls. Consider switching this flag to "true" if you experience repeated ClassLoader access for non-existing BeanInfo classes, in case such access is expensive on startup or on lazy loading.
items.translation: 默认值为 "false"，会考虑所有 `BeanInfo` 元数据类，就像对标准的 Introspector.getBeanInfo(Class) 调用一样。如果您在启动或懒加载时，发现对不存在的 `BeanInfo` 类存在重复的 ClassLoader 访问且该访问代价昂贵，请考虑将此标志切换为 "true"。

items.source: Note that such an effect may also indicate a scenario where caching doesn't work effectively: Prefer an arrangement where the Spring jars live in the same ClassLoader as the application classes, which allows for clean caching along with the application's lifecycle in any case. For a web application, consider declaring a local IntrospectorCleanupListener in web.xml in case of a multi-ClassLoader layout, which will allow for effective caching as well.
items.translation: 请注意，此类效果也可能表明缓存无法有效工作：请采用一种 Spring jar 与应用类位于同一 ClassLoader 中的配置，这样无论如何都能实现与应用生命周期同步的干净缓存。对于 Web 应用程序，如果在多 ClassLoader 布局下，请在 web.xml 中声明一个本地的IntrospectorCleanupListener，以便同样实现有效的缓存。

items.source: Ordered at Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE to allow other user-defined BeanInfoFactory types to take precedence.
items.translation: 在 Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE 处排序，以允许其他用户定义的BeanInfoFactory类型具有优先权。

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。

items.translation: 指示 Spring 在调用 JavaBeans Introspector 时使用 Introspector.IGNORE_ALL_BEANINFO 模式的系统属性："spring.beaninfo.ignore"，其值为 "true" 时会跳过对 BeanInfo 类的搜索（通常用于应用程序中根本未为 Bean 定义此类类的场景）。
